blocks/bom.rst.reason: The shared file decoder removes the UTF-8 byte order mark before parsing.

blocks/initial-and-surname.rst.reason: A lone initial and surname is prose. Docutils reads the standalone line as an upper-alpha list; another item or indented body disambiguates a real list.

blocks/mismatched-overline.rst.reason: Show the malformed decoration and count the occurrence in print checks.

directives/sphinx-changed.rst.reason: Display the version and the change description.

directives/sphinx-code.rst.reason: Apply caption, line numbering and line emphasis to the listing.

directives/sphinx-deprecated.rst.reason: Retain the deprecation version and description.

directives/sphinx-index.rst.reason: Omit the index instruction and keep the following paragraph.

directives/sphinx-seealso.rst.reason: Render the related material in an informative callout.

directives/sphinx-tree.rst.reason: Render sibling document titles in a list without navigation.

directives/sphinx-version.rst.reason: Display the version in which the feature appeared.

directives/unknown.rst.reason: Show the name and source in a neutral callout, including nested options or commands.

inline/bad-link.rst.reason: Leave unresolved references legible and count them without diagnostic hyperlinks or an error section.

inline/numbered-substitution.rst.reason: A substitution containing an identifying footnote is invalid. Retain the definition and the references as source instead of inserting diagnostic links.

inline/sphinx-roles.rst.reason: Display the Sphinx label, key and shortened function name without cross-file resolution.

inline/unknown-role.rst.reason: Show the original role text and count the unrecognized role.
